prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-20922 from Dunmore Analytics
prose.body:
Hi Corvane Labs team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-20922 for our recent collaboration.

The total amount due is 5049.01 USDC. We noticed this hasn't cleared on our end yet, so we wanted to send a gentle reminder to keep things moving smoothly on both sides.

To settle this, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0x43b71911388e8f4487e873c1b440f28b2eadc594

This is our usual address for all outgoing USDC payments from Dunmore Analytics, so you can feel confident sending it there. If you've already sent the payment, please ignore this note, we'll cross that bridge when the transaction lands!

If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the original PDF, just hit reply. We’re happy to help.

Thanks for your prompt attention and continued partnership.

Best regards,

Accounts Payable Team
Dunmore Analytics
